title: Oregon coast vacation
content: I remember going to the Oregon coast with Dad and Michael when we were little. I think it was summer 1986. We rented a tiny cottage near the beach. My strongest memory is building sandcastles together.

title: Oregon coast vacation
content: I remember a family trip to the Oregon coast. Dad took us crabbing but we caught nothing. He bought crab from a fisherman at the dock and joked that he had caught it himself. I'm not sure of the year, possibly 1987.

title: Family beach photograph
content: A faded photograph shows three children building a sandcastle on the Oregon coast. The back of the photograph is handwritten 'Summer 1986'. The children appear to be Sarah, Michael, and their cousin Lisa, based on Helen's identification.

title: Grandma's kitchen on Sundays
content: Mom made bread on Sundays. She always gave the children the first warm slices after church.

title: Grandma's bread baking day
content: I remember Mom baking bread on Saturday evenings, not Sundays. She put the bread on the kitchen windowsill to cool.

title: Washington coast trip
content: We visited the Washington coast in 1992. We stayed in a tent. No one went crabbing on that outing.

title: Alex Morgan garden
content: I planted sunflowers in the garden in 2001.

title: Alex Reed train
content: I travelled by train to Denver in 1999. I remember the station clock.
